arxiv-2209-05489.title: AIROPA IV: Validating Point Spread Function Reconstruction on Various Science Cases
arxiv-2209-05489.creator: Sean K. Terry, Jessica R. Lu, Paolo Turri, Anna Ciurlo, Abhimat Gautam, Tuan Do, Michael P. Fitzgerald, Andrea Ghez, Matthew Hosek Jr, Gunther Witzel
arxiv-2209-05489.description: Abstract We present an analysis of six independent on-sky datasets taken with the Keck-II/NIRC2 instrument. Using the off-axis point spread function (PSF) reconstruction software AIROPA, we extract stellar astrometry, photometry, and other fitting metrics in order to characterize the performance of this package.

arxiv-2311-00233.title: Instructive Decoding: Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models are Self-Refiner from Noisy Instructions
arxiv-2311-00233.creator: Taehyeon Kim, Joonkee Kim, Gihun Lee, Se-Young YunKAIST AI
arxiv-2311-00233.description: Abstract While instruction-tuned language models have demonstrated impressive zero-shot generalization, these models often struggle to generate accurate responses when faced with instructions that fall outside their training set. This paper presents Instructive Decoding (ID), a simple yet effective approach that augments the efficacy of instruction-tuned models.

arxiv-2407-08385.description: Abstract Determining the approximate degree composition for Boolean functions remains a significant unsolved problem in Boolean function complexity. arxiv-2501-04034.title: Mirror Descent Methods with Weighting Scheme for Outputs for Constrained Variational Inequality Problems
arxiv-2501-04034.creator: Mohammad S. Alkousa, Belal A. Alashqar, Fedor S. Stonyakin, Tarek Nabhani, Seydamet S. Ablaev
arxiv-2501-04034.description: Abstract . This paper is devoted to the variational inequality problems. We consider two classes of problems, the first is classical constrained variational inequality, and the second is the same problem with functional (inequality type) constraints. To solve these problems, we propose mirror descent-type methods with a weighting scheme for the generated points in each iteration of the algorithms.

arxiv-2503-22573.title: A Framework for Cryptographic Verifiability of End-to-End AI Pipelines
arxiv-2503-22573.creator: Kar Balan, Robert Learney, Tim Wood
arxiv-2503-22573.description: Abstract . The increasing integration of Artificial Intelligence across multiple industry sectors necessitates robust mechanisms for ensuring transparency, trust, and auditability of its development and deployment. This topic is particularly important in light of recent calls in various jurisdictions to introduce regulation and legislation on AI safety.

pmc-10764969.title: Global population surpasses eight billion: Are we ready for the next billion?
pmc-10764969.creator: Nityanand Jain, Islam Kourampi, Tungki Pratama Umar, Zahra Rose Almansoor, Ayush Anand, Mohammad Ebad Ur Rehman, Shivani Jain, Aigars Reinis
pmc-10764969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In November 2022, the global population had officially crossed eight billion. It has long been recognized that socioeconomic or health-related problems in the community always accompany an uncontrolled population expansion. International calls have been made regarding lack of universal health coverage, an insufficient supply of healthcare providers, the burden of noncommunicable disease, population aging and the difficulty in obtaining safe drinking water and food.

pmc-11075013.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness and Safety of Robotic-Assisted MRI/TRUS Fusion Transperineal Prostate Biopsy Systems: A Narrative Review Based on Current Literature
pmc-11075013.creator: Akif Erbin, Ufuk Caglar, Rustu Turkay
pmc-11075013.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Robotic-assisted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)/transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) fusion transperineal biopsy systems are one of the most debated and interesting subjects both in practice and in current urology literature. The comprehensive literature research was carried out in the PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, and Scopus databases using the terms “robotic transperineal prostate biopsy,” “robot-assisted MRI/US fusion biopsy,” “robot-assisted MRI/TRUS fusion biopsy,” or “robotic targeted prostate biopsies.” All article types were included in the study (n = 343).

pmc-12454312.title: Association of spicy food consumption with colorectal polyp and adenoma prevalence: findings from the Lanxi Pre-Colorectal Cancer Cohort (LP3C)
pmc-12454312.creator: Peiling Hu, Xinran Yan, Xiaodong Hu, Xunan Lin, Jing Zhao, Fuzhen Pan, Xiaohui Liu, Hao Ye, Pan Zhuang, Yu Zhang, Weifang Zheng, Jingjing Jiao
pmc-12454312.description: ObjectiveThis study examined the relationship between habitual spicy food intake and the risk of colorectal polyps and adenomas in a high-risk Chinese cohort.MethodsWe analyzed baseline data from 14,907 participants aged 40–80 years enrolled in the Lanxi Precolorectal Cancer Cohort (LP3C) between March 2018 and December 2022.

pmc-12605950.title: Intimate partner violence among women with multiple sclerosis
pmc-12605950.creator: Masoud Etemadifar, Omid Zamani, Anahita Bahrami‐Zadegan, Mehri Salari, Amir Reza Mansouri
pmc-12605950.description: AimIntimate partner violence (IPV), a highly prevalent issue in women with chronic disorders, is rarely discussed and remains unrecognized, especially among patients with Multiple Sclerosis (MS). The objective of this study is to assess the prevalence and characteristics of IPV among female patients with MS.

pmc-12612257.title: Mechanically steered photon upconversion and circularly polarized luminescence in stretchable photonic crystal films
pmc-12612257.creator: Zhi-Wang Luo, Honghan Ji, Xue Jin, Jun Song, Zhen-Qiang Yu, Pengfei Duan, Tonghan Zhao
pmc-12612257.description: Photon-upconverted circularly polarized luminescence (UC-CPL) based on triplet-triplet annihilation (TTA) holds considerable promise for innovative applications. However, existing strategies encounter difficulties in concurrently achieving tunable TTA photon upconversion (TTA-UC) performance and a high luminescence dissymmetry factor (glum) in the solid state. In this study, we design and fabricate flexible and stable upconverted stretchable photonic crystal (SPC) films.

pmc-13371599.title: Stakeholder insights into hospital-home transitions for older adults in a decentralised health system: a qualitative study
pmc-13371599.creator: Laura Maria Steiner, Sandra M. G. Zwakhalen, Loris Bonetti, Alissa Borner, Agata Ferrari, Sabine Hahn
pmc-13371599.description: BackgroundHospital-home transitions are critical points in the care trajectory for older adults, requiring alignment between clinical decision-making, communication, and home-based support to maintain care continuity. In decentralised health systems, where responsibilities are distributed across multiple providers, these transitions may be vulnerable to fragmentation.

pmc-13390657.title: Altered TRPM3‐Dependent Cytosolic and Mitochondrial Calcium Influx in Natural Killer Cells of Post‐COVID‐19 Condition Patients
pmc-13390657.creator: Chandi Tabeth Magawa, Natalie Eaton‐Fitch, Katsuhiko Muraki, Sonya Marshall‐Gradisnik
pmc-13390657.description: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), approximately 6% of COVID‐19 cases develop serious long‐term sequelae referred to as post‐COVID‐19 condition (PCC). Immunological disturbances such as persistent activation of immune cells and reduced cytotoxicity by natural killer (NK) cells are reported as key aspects in PCC.

uslaw-usc-t42-s1437bbb3.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 8 (Low-Income Housing); Subchapter II–B (Home Rule Flexible Grant Demonstration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general In each fiscal year of the demonstration program under this subchapter, amounts made available to a participating jurisdiction under the demonstration program shall be subject to the same terms and conditions as such.
